- leave FA-8 (F-19b/R2-004) non-strict: it is skipif-gated on a live OPENROUTER_API_KEY not available this dry-run pass, so its current pass/fail state could not be re-verified without a live provider call

- markers-only; no defect fixes; Cluster D darwin xfails untouched (already strict, owned by R2/TP-RTE-WALKER-006)

## Validation
